notes: EXERCISES IS NOW A GAME. Every right answer earns XP (more for quick answers and for runs of 5 in a row), and XP raises your player level. Pick a daily goal (Casual to Intense); the Learn tab shows a dot until you reach it. Finish a level each day to build a streak: every 7 days in a row earns a streak freeze that covers a missed day. The course is now a path: each step opens when you pass a level in the one before it, or skip ahead with a jump test (9 of 10). New 60-second sprints test your speed and keep your record for each step. The new Progress tab charts your XP per day, practice minutes and answer speed by week, with your speed and accuracy for each topic. The Topics tab still lets you practice anything freely.
